description: NCLT order approving an insolvency resolution plan under IBC Section 30(6)/31(1). Contains: CoC vote percentages, payment schedule to creditors, haircut/recovery amounts, approval of resolution applicant, moratorium cessation, monitoring committee.

NCLT order admitting a petition under IBC Section 7, 9, or 10 and commencing CIRP. Contains: appointment of Interim Resolution Professional (IRP), moratorium declaration, CIRP commencement date, debt default amount.

NCLT order directing liquidation of corporate debtor under IBC Section 33. Contains: appointment of liquidator, liquidation commencement, rejection of resolution plans, distribution waterfall under Section 53.

Information Memorandum (IM) prepared by Resolution Professional under IBC Regulation 36. Contains: corporate debtor business overview, financial statements, asset details, valuation reports, encumbrances, litigation summary, employee details.

Resolution plan document submitted by a resolution applicant (SRA) to the CoC. Contains: proposed payment amounts to each creditor class, funding sources, implementation milestones, Section 29A eligibility declaration.

Petition filed to initiate CIRP under IBC Section 7 (financial creditor), Section 9 (operational creditor), or Section 10 (corporate debtor itself). Contains: default amount, debt evidence, creditor/debtor details.

Interlocutory or interim NCLT/NCLAT order during ongoing CIRP proceedings. Contains: hearing dates, procedural directions, stay/extension orders, interim relief on specific IAs (interlocutory applications).
NCLAT or Supreme Court order in an appeal against an NCLT order. Contains: grounds of appeal, appellate bench, challenge to resolution plan or liquidation, Section 61/62 IBC references.

Registered valuer report determining fair value and liquidation value of corporate debtor assets under CIRP Regulation 27. Contains: valuation methodology, asset schedules, fair value, liquidation value.
Any IBC-related document not matching the above categories: committee minutes, form submissions, compliance certificates, miscellaneous orders.
